summary: CareerOS GPS de carrière lot (journey bar + 6 milestones + next-step banner + guided tour + InfoTips + Mode Débutant/Expert + action hierarchy). Backend 10/10 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_journey.py: GET /api/careeros/journey returns correct {steps(5),milestones(6),completed,total=6,next{step,title,text,cta,to,time},preferences}; 401 without Bearer; fresh account -> next.step='memory' / completed=0; after PUT /api/careeros/profile with CV>=200 chars + target_roles (string) + location -> profile milestone done + memory step done + next.step='radar' with title containing 'Radar' and to='/careeros/radar'. PATCH /api/auth/preferences: 401 unauth, 422 empty body, 422 invalid guide_mode, 422 invalid theme, 200 partial {guide_mode:'expert'}+{tour_done:true}+{theme:'dark'} all persist independently and merge in db (verified via GET /api/auth/me). Frontend verified on preview URL with 3 fresh accounts: (A) register -> guided-tour auto-opens at 'étape 1 sur 5' with 'Temps estimé : 2 min'; tour-open-page navigates to /careeros/memoire and tour stays open on step 1; 5x tour-next reaches final summary 'CareerOS est prêt' with tour-finish; after reload tour does NOT reappear. (B) second fresh account tour-skip closes tour and never reappears across reload nor navigation across /careeros, /radar, /memoire, /nouveau. (C) help-restart-tour reopens tour; help-mode-expert hides journey-bar, next-step-banner, concept-row and infotips on all pages and persists after reload; help-mode-beginner restores them. journey-bar renders on /careeros, /careeros/radar, /careeros/memoire, /careeros/nouveau with all 5 journey-step-{memory,radar,pack,interview,followup}; exactly 1 element has aria-current=step; journey-progress badge shows '0/6 terminées' and popover lists 6 milestone-{profile,radar,offer,pack,sent,interview}. next-step-banner shows exactly one next-step-cta (or next-step-here if on target page). concept-row on Dashboard; clicking infotip opens infotip-content-* with French text (e.g. 'Indice de probabilité d'entrevue…'). Action hierarchy: PackView shows prepare-interview-btn (primary) + pack-more-btn whose menu contains compare-versions-btn + destructive delete-application-btn after separator. Radar OfferCard shows 'Générer le pack' primary + 'Analyse approfondie' secondary + radar-more-{id} Plus menu with radar-open-{id} 'Voir l'offre' (ignore item only present when status != 'pack' AND != 'ignoree', correct per spec). Mobile 390px: 0px horizontal overflow, only 1 step label visible (compact), journey-bar visible, next-step-cta width 324px (~95% of content width). Dark/indigo theme readable.

issues: 'Date de publication' input uses native browser date picker (<input type='date'> with mm/dd/yyyy placeholder). Per the design rule to prefer shadcn calendar for a consistent French locale UX, consider switching to a shadcn <Calendar> inside a Popover (dd/mm/yyyy localized, dark-theme aware).

action_items: (design, low priority) Replace native <input type='date'> on NewPack with shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistent French (dd/mm/yyyy) locale and dark-theme styling.

(copy, info) On fresh account the final tour summary text correctly says 'Prochaine étape : Lancez votre premier Radar' only after profile is filled; before that it falls back to 'compléter votre Career Memory' default — consider refreshing journey right before showing the end slide so the message is always current.
critical_code_review_comments: GuideProvider.useEffect that opens the tour depends on [journey, pathname] but ignores exhaustive-deps for `user` and `tour`; relies on sessionStorage key careeros.tour. If sessionStorage is cleared mid-session but preferences.tour_done==true, logic is still correct (tour_done gate wins). OK — but adding `user` to deps would prevent a rare race where journey arrives before auth hydration.

journey.py builds `done = {... 'pack': bool(apps) ...}` which flags the pack step as done as soon as any application exists (even status='queued'/'error'). Consider aligning with milestones (`pack` milestone requires status in {done, partial}) to avoid showing a green pack step for a failed pack.

journey.py `done['followup']` becomes True on ANY email sent (any kind), while the business milestone 'remerciement' is more specific. Minor UX inconsistency between the 5-step trail (any email counts) vs the dedicated past-interview-thank-you banner CTA.

`preferences` is merged client-side in GuideProvider via `setPrefs((p) => ({...p, ...patch}))`, but the backend returns the full merged preferences object in PATCH response; the client discards that and risks drift if backend coerces values. Prefer `setPrefs(res.preferences)`.

Journey component conditions on `beginner`; expert users still see JourneyBar/NextStep returning null — good. But data-testid journey-bar/next-step-banner/concept-row vanish entirely in expert, which is correct behavior but worth documenting for QA (we did test it).

Tour's final-step CTA auto-navigates to `journey.next.to` without refreshing journey first — if the user filled Career Memory during the tour the final 'Prochaine étape' sentence may still reference the pre-tour state until next journey refresh (navigation triggers it, so acceptable).
